official_definition: (Ultimate Trigger/Cross Ultimate Trigger: Send a card from the opposing deck to the Trash. If that card's cost is lower than this Ultimate's, it's a hit.)

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Cross Ultimate Trigger] or [Cross Ultimate Trigger: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Cross Ultimate Trigger]", "give [Cross Ultimate Trigger]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
